svg.title: Acoustic end-to-end pipeline v2 group meeting edition
svg.desc: Four dataset-native inputs feed dataset-specific preprocessing, one of five fully expanded encoder alternatives, optional adapters or fusion, and dataset-native prediction heads.

text.tspan: unit A: event → binary + seven classes
I / E / D / Wheeze / Rhonchi / Stridor
paper tasks: I, E, CAS, DAS
missing gap is not a negative label
three B / D / E filter replicas per patient

svg.text: waveform [B,T] / fbank [B,C,F,τ] → pooled [B,D]; temporal output additionally requires tokens [B,L,D] + token_mask [B,L] + time_map [B,L,2]

text.tspan: N / patch / heads / MLP width not exposed; remain symbolic
metrics: SE, SP, Score, macro-F1, UAR
event and recording are separate tasks
inter is primary; intra is diagnostic
metrics: SE / SP / AS / HS + macro-F1
AST / OPERA / HeAR / PANNs: pooled only
aggregate windows before one recording decision
diagnosis and shared mapping remain separate
